description.value: ABURI Market is an elevated Japanese grocerant by ABURI Restaurants Canada, the award-winning team behind Miku and Minami, situated at Granville Station inside CF Pacific Centre in downtown Vancouver. It functions as both a specialty grocery and prepared-foods counter, stocking A5 Iwate Wagyu (of which it is the exclusive Canadian retailer), Hyoketsu flash-frozen sashimi-grade seafood, imported Japanese snacks, sauces, tableware, and ready-to-eat bento and bowls. A touring cyclist passing through downtown Vancouver will find it a convenient stop for high-quality provisions unlikely to be found at a conventional supermarket.
